title: Watch wild manatees in clear spring water
description: Observe wintering manatees from elevated boardwalks above protected warm-water refuges. A peaceful wildlife experience without entering the water.
teaser: See gentle giants from a waterside boardwalk.
whyItMightDelightYou: A peaceful chance to watch gentle wildlife from the boardwalk.
goodToKnow: Winter gatherings vary with the weather. Confirm current viewing access and shuttle arrangements. The idea is to watch from land, without swimming.
